name: terra-observation-logger
description: A local-first nature journal with Projects / Field Summary and a second Add to TERRA project action that reuses observation IDs. Includes staged AI-suggested, community-identified and expert-confirmed provenance definitions, plus separate unconnected BOLD/GenBank plans with temporary DNA syntax previews. Preserves six-field JSON and existing mock photo tools. No remote calls, sequence persistence, uploads or publishing; documented staged integration roadmap.
